canonical_unit_note: ₹/running metre. A 3 m CPVC length and a 6 m GI length cannot share a price band — length_m is a SKU attribute and the conversion is length → running_metre, never a guess.
scope_note: Plumbing branch only. Electrical conduit (rigid PVC, flexible, FRLS, casing-capping, HDPE DWC, MS/GI conduit) is a separate L1 branch under Electrical › Conduit & raceway with its own tree — it shares the word 'pipe' and almost none of the filters.
counts_note: Counts measured from data/buildobjects.db on 2026-08-17 for hyderabad. Each count is a number of OFFERS, not products: the results list shows one card per vendor, so the rail counts sellers' listings and these numbers match it exactly. A facet marked data_backed:false has no field behind it in the collected data and ships disabled with a reason.
lead_reason: The material decides which pressure-rating vocabulary even applies. SDR, Class, Type and PN are four unrelated systems, and a panel that flattens them into one 'Class' list lets a buyer express an impossible requirement.
panel_regime: over 100 products — full tree, 7 primary + 5 conditional

filters.label: System
filters.why: The defining decision, and the parent of every pressure-class filter below. Choosing CPVC reveals SDR; choosing GI reveals Light/Medium/Heavy. They never appear together.
filters.no_data_reason: No collected listing in hyderabad populates `attrs.pipe_system`. The facet is retained and shipped disabled rather than deleted, so the gap is visible rather than silently absent.

filters.label: Size (nominal bore)
filters.why: The spec the plumber arrives with. Both vocabularies are shown because Indian sites use mm and inches interchangeably — a buyer told 'one inch' on site must find 1" on the page.
filters.note: The mm↔inch mapping is nominal trade sizing, not arithmetic: 25 mm is called 1" though 1" is 25.4 mm, and 4" SWR is 110 mm OD. It is a table with tests, never ×25.4. Top six by count shown; 50, 75, 160, 200 mm behind 'show all'.
filters.no_data_reason: No collected listing in hyderabad populates `attrs.nominal_bore_mm`. The facet is retained and shipped disabled rather than deleted, so the gap is visible rather than silently absent.

filters.label: Pressure class — SDR
filters.why: Determines hot-water suitability — the second question after bore, and meaningless on any material other than CPVC.
filters.no_data_reason: No collected listing in hyderabad populates `attrs.sdr`. The facet is retained and shipped disabled rather than deleted, so the gap is visible rather than silently absent.

filters.label: Pressure class
filters.why: IS 4985 rates uPVC in working pressure classes. Showing these beside SDR-11 would be incoherent — they are different rating systems for different materials.
filters.no_data_reason: No collected listing in hyderabad populates `attrs.pressure_class`. The facet is retained and shipped disabled rather than deleted, so the gap is visible rather than silently absent.

filters.label: SWR type
filters.why: IS 13592 splits SWR by duty. Type B is the wall thickness for soil and waste; using Type A there is a failure in a few years.
filters.no_data_reason: No collected listing in hyderabad populates `attrs.swr_type`. The facet is retained and shipped disabled rather than deleted, so the gap is visible rather than silently absent.

filters.label: GI class
filters.why: IS 1239 classes are identified on site by their painted colour band. Printing the colour beside the class is the detail that makes a plumber trust the page.
filters.no_data_reason: No collected listing in hyderabad populates `attrs.gi_class`. The facet is retained and shipped disabled rather than deleted, so the gap is visible rather than silently absent.

filters.label: PE grade
filters.why: IS 4984 rates HDPE by resin grade, which sets the pressure rating at a given wall thickness.
filters.no_data_reason: No collected listing in hyderabad populates `attrs.pe_grade`. The facet is retained and shipped disabled rather than deleted, so the gap is visible rather than silently absent.

filters.why: Below spec here, unlike cement — a plumber arrives with a bore and a class, not a brand. Ordered by result count.
filters.no_data_reason: No brand was resolvable on any collected listing for this category and city.

filters.label: Length
filters.why: Kept primary rather than folded because it drives both freight and the ₹/length ↔ ₹/m conversion, and a site with a 3 m ceiling buys differently from one ordering coil.
filters.no_data_reason: No collected listing in hyderabad populates `attrs.length_m`. The facet is retained and shipped disabled rather than deleted, so the gap is visible rather than silently absent.

filters.label: BIS mark
filters.why: Labels, never hides. Pipes are not under a quality-control order the way cement and rebar are, so an unmarked pipe is listed and ranked like any other — with the fact stated.
filters.note: Default off. Pre-applying it would be a decision we are not entitled to make on the buyer's behalf.
filters.no_data_reason: No collected listing in hyderabad populates `offer.cert_state`. The facet is retained and shipped disabled rather than deleted, so the gap is visible rather than silently absent.

filters.label: Arrives
filters.why: Computed per pincode from the freight model, not stored on the product.
filters.no_data_reason: No collected listing in hyderabad populates `serviceability.lead_time_days`. The facet is retained and shipped disabled rather than deleted, so the gap is visible rather than silently absent.

filters.label: Joint
filters.why: Decides which fittings and which consumable (solvent cement vs thread seal) the buyer also needs. Folded because it is largely implied by System.
filters.no_data_reason: `attrs.joint_type` is populated on 2 of 304 listings in hyderabad, but as uncontrolled seller text ("Solvent Cement / Rubber Ring (depending ") which matches none of this filter's values. The gap is normalisation, not collection: shipped disabled rather than deleted, and rather than mapped by guess.

filters.label: IS standard
filters.why: Professional buyers specify by IS code. Folded because it is one-to-one with System for most of the catalogue.
filters.no_data_reason: No collected listing in hyderabad populates `product.cert_standards`. The facet is retained and shipped disabled rather than deleted, so the gap is visible rather than silently absent.

filters.label: Seller quotes price
filters.why: The worked example in the spec: an ex-GST ₹402 quoted against a delivered ₹502.36 understates by 25.0%. Making the basis filterable is how that comparison stops being possible.
filters.no_data_reason: No collected listing in hyderabad populates `offer.gst_treatment`. The facet is retained and shipped disabled rather than deleted, so the gap is visible rather than silently absent.

filters.label: Price verified
filters.why: Pipes are volatility class V1 — a 7 day SLA, because PVC resin is commodity-linked and brands revise list prices several times a year.
filters.no_data_reason: No collected listing in hyderabad populates `price_current.freshness_state`. The facet is retained and shipped disabled rather than deleted, so the gap is visible rather than silently absent.

filters.label: Country of origin
filters.why: Indexed and sortable from day one — LMPC Rule 6(10A).
filters.no_data_reason: No collected listing in hyderabad populates `product.country_of_origin`. The facet is retained and shipped disabled rather than deleted, so the gap is visible rather than silently absent.

omitted.reason: Moved to a toggle above the results. Single binary, and the rail slot is worth more to a class filter.
Fixed per material — CPVC is cream, uPVC white or grey, SWR usually white. One value per branch, so it eliminates nothing.
Restates pressure class exactly. 'Hot water' is what SDR-11 means; showing both splits the result set twice for one decision.

A real system, but commercial and industrial rather than residential, and the collection sweep found no PPR supply in either target city. Left out rather than shipped as an empty branch — if PPR appears in a later run it earns a sixth System value and its own conditional PN filter.
Held back until there is a real ratings corpus.
